name: animated-chat-bubble
title: Animated Chat Bubble
description: Chat bubbles with streaming replies, reactions and swipe to reply.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. Sent bubbles take its primary colour, replies its muted colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the chosen palette.

props.name: animateEnter
props.label: Animate enter
props.description: New messages slide and fade in as they arrive.

props.name: typing
props.label: Typing indicator
props.description: Shows typing dots before each reply appears.

props.name: streamText
props.label: Stream text
props.description: Replies type themselves out word by word.

props.name: flyIn
props.label: Fly from input
props.description: A sent message flies up from the input box into the chat.

props.name: showDeliveryStatus
props.label: Show delivery status
props.description: Shows sending, sent and failed under your messages.

props.name: shakeOnError
props.label: Shake on error
props.description: A message that fails to send shakes. Needs Simulate failures on.

props.name: simulateFailures
props.label: Simulate failures
props.description: Some sends fail at random, to preview the error state.

props.name: popOnChange
props.label: Pop on change
props.description: Reaction pills pop in and out as they change.

props.name: rollingNumbers
props.label: Rolling numbers
props.description: Reaction counts roll to their new number.

props.name: doubleClickToReact
props.label: Double click to react
props.description: Double-clicking a bubble adds a heart, or takes it off again.

props.name: showReactionPicker
props.label: Show reaction picker
props.description: Shows a row of emoji to react with on each bubble.

props.name: magnifyEmojis
props.label: Magnify emojis
props.description: Emoji in the picker grow as the pointer passes over them. Needs Show reaction picker on.

props.name: liftOnHover
props.label: Lift on hover
props.description: Bubbles rise slightly on hover and press in on click.

props.name: selectable
props.label: Selectable text
props.description: Lets message text be selected and copied.

props.name: swipeToReply
props.label: Swipe to reply
props.description: Drag a bubble sideways to reply to it.

props.name: showSuggestions
props.label: Show suggestions
props.description: Shows suggested replies you can tap to send.

props.name: collapsible
props.label: Collapsible
props.description: Long messages are clipped with a Show more toggle.

props.name: joined
props.label: Joined corners
props.description: Bubbles in a run from the same person share tighter corners.

props.name: sendStyle
props.label: Sent bubble style
props.description: Look of the messages you send.
